text: PING is wholly owned by its founding Solheim family: president and CEO John K. Solheim says the family owns the whole company, with no private equity and no outside shareholders.
short: PING is wholly owned by the Solheim family

source.name: MyGolfSpy: Why Being Family-Run For 67 Years Makes PING More Than A Little Bit Different
source.quote: “The Solheim family owns the whole thing,” says John K. “There’s no private equity, no outside shareholders or anything like that.”
